name: GO Birkirkara Data Centre
notes: GO's wholesale page says it offers secure hosting and co-location services at its state-of-the-art data centre in Birkirkara, with direct core-network connectivity, redundant control units, CCTV, fire protection, and ISO27001/PCI DSS compliance. Capacity not disclosed.

name: CSL Data Centre Services Birkirkara facility
developer: CSL Data Centre Services / M. Demajo Group
notes: CSL lists its address as 66 Dun Karm Street, B'Kara, Malta, and describes its own Tier 3-rated, carrier-neutral data centre facilities with 2000 square meters of rack space. Its features page cites power from the grid with a dedicated 2 MW substation; this is facility power, not confirmed IT load.
